target_customer: Frontier AI labs and AI infrastructure buyers who need more energy efficient inference and training hardware
problem: GPUs spend most energy moving data, making AI compute costly and power hungry.
business_model: Hardware sales (XPU chips, FPGA devkits) and hosted cluster access

founders.name: Elias Almqvist
education: Chalmers University of Technology, Computer Engineering (dropped out)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists only him; a Swedish outlet and aggregators name Prithvi Raj as co-founder and CTO but the fetched YC page did not.

competitors.name: NVIDIA H100
competitors.what: Incumbent GPU baseline used for the company's 27.6x efficiency claim

technical_complexity.rationale: Reconfigurable AI chip design, FPGA prototype and path to silicon from a tiny team needs hardware breakthroughs and capital.

defensibility.rationale: Chip architecture is hard to replicate if it works, but performance claims are company stated and unproven at silicon scale.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: NVIDIA and well funded chip startups kept dominating; no direct incumbent action against the company found.

market_need_then: AI inference energy cost and GPU scarcity in 2024 created demand for efficient alternatives; evidence is the company's own litepaper claim.

branding.name_origin: Coverage of the rename says the name signals a thousandfold larger scale target than exascale; this is secondary framing, not a founder statement I opened.
branding.domain_note: Uses zscc.ai abbreviation; legal entity Exa Laboratories, Inc. operates Zettascale as a DBA

identity.visual_style: Research and space-compute themes including a Dyson Swarm vision
identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious, superintelligence framing, tagline AI silicon built for discovery

rebrands.why: Secondary coverage ties it to a larger scale ambition; trademark application filed 2025-08-28

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage with little independent press; rename came a year after launch.

outcome_analysis: Zettascale, formerly Exa Laboratories, is active and pre-revenue as far as sources show, offering FPGA devkit pre-orders for XPU Grasshopper and planning silicon. It renamed in September 2025 and announces large efficiency claims that are unverified. Capital needs for chips are high and no funding beyond named YC and angel backers was documented, so the outcome is uncertain.
notes: No dated funding round found; aggregators claim a $500K pre-seed Sep 2024 and the site names Y Combinator, Olive Tree Capital and Soma Capital without amounts, so none recorded. Rename date from secondary sources. Etched, Groq and Cerebras coverage found was 2026 dated and is not treated as founding era competition. YC lists team size 2.
